statement: The input is a Python 3 function that is meant to return the sum over i of xs[i] * ys[i], taken modulo m (xs and ys have the same length, m is positive). It contains exactly one bug: an off-by-one, a wrong operator, or a wrong initial value. Fix the bug, then evaluate the corrected function for the call `dot_mod([24, 1, 19, 19, 15, 6, 22, 5, 21, 26], [23, 30, 10, 34, 38, 35, 10, 5, 18, 10], 75)`. Answer with the integer it returns.
title: Blue belt: fix dot_mod
